title: docs: Add project management README (docs/README.md)
head: docs/readme-project-management-processes
body:
## Summary

Add a docs/README.md index for the OctoAcme process documents and include a brief overview of the project management processes used across the team.

## Changes

- Create a docs/README.md landing page for all project management guidance
- Add a concise summary of OctoAcme’s project management lifecycle and responsibilities
- Link each process document in the docs/ folder for easier discovery and onboarding

Closes #4
